mentions.name: RunProm
mentions.description: This tool runs AI prompts on a schedule, letting users automate recurring prompt executions. It is being polished for a bigger launch, with early users already interested in paying for it.
mentions.problem: There was no good way to run prompts on a schedule.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m building https://runprom.pt.  I’ve been enjoying building it so far and it’s amazing to see that there’s people interested in paying for it!

I’ve always had a pet peeve that there’s no a good way to run prompts on a schedule…
